market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is an obscure political figure with no national polling or major party backing for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election. The second-place finisher in the first round is almost certain to be a major candidate (e.g., Lula, Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas). The market-implied 6.7% chance vastly overstates his true probability, which is near zero.
evidence_points: No major electoral forecasts or polls list Renan Santos as a presidential contender for 2026.
Second-place in Brazil's first round historically goes to the main opposition candidate, typically from a major coalition.
The chance of a virtually unknown candidate surging to second place ahead of established national figures is extremely remote.
